question: Should #54397 stay open as the canonical umbrella for the remaining topic/session management scope, or should maintainers split and close it now that the Web UI/session-thread slice has landed?
rationale: Current main partially satisfies the request, but the unimplemented pieces require product choices about CLI/TUI parity, metadata shape, topic families, import/export semantics, and whether broad umbrella tracking is still useful.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Keep #54397 open as the canonical product tracker while narrower issues and PRs land the remaining CLI, TUI, metadata, and import/export slices.

options.title: Split then close umbrella
options.body: Create or nominate narrower canonical issues for each accepted residual slice, then close #54397 as superseded by those product-scoped items.

options.title: Declare current scope sufficient
options.body: Close #54397 with a product decision that labels, groups, archive/pin, checkpointing, and current slash commands are the intended scope for now.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Keep #54397 open as the canonical product tracker while narrower issues and PRs land the remaining CLI, TUI, metadata, and import/export slices.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged session-thread management and session UI/protocol work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the remaining product-shape decision.
